queries.name: skills Top 10
queries.sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM job_skill js INNER JOIN skill s ON s.id = js.skill_id INNER JOIN job j ON j.id = js.job_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY job_count DESC, s.name ASC LIMIT 10

explain.Extra: Using index; Using temporary; Using filesort

explain_analyze:
-> Limit: 10 row(s)  (actual time=180..180 rows=10 loops=1)
    -> Sort: job_count DESC, s.`name`, limit input to 10 row(s) per chunk  (actual time=180..180 rows=10 loops=1)
        -> Table scan on <temporary>  (actual time=180..180 rows=18 loops=1)
            -> Aggregate using temporary table  (actual time=180..180 rows=18 loops=1)
                -> Nested loop inner join  (cost=57333 rows=127186) (actual time=0.0632..139 rows=119971 loops=1)
                    -> Nested loop inner join  (cost=12818 rows=127186) (actual time=0.0584..21.1 rows=119971 loops=1)
                        -> Covering index scan on s using uk_skill_name  (cost=2.05 rows=18) (actual time=0.0134..0.0357 rows=18 loops=1)
                        -> Covering index lookup on js using idx_job_skill_skill_id (skill_id=s.id)  (cost=44.7 rows=7066) (actual time=0.0431..0.923 rows=6665 loops=18)
                    -> Single-row covering index lookup on j using PRIMARY (id=js.job_id)  (cost=0.25 rows=1) (actual time=866e-6..883e-6 rows=1 loops=119971)

queries.name: salary GROUP BY
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS job_count, CAST(ROUND(AVG(salary_min), 0) AS SIGNED) AS average_salary_min, CAST(ROUND(AVG(salary_max), 0) AS SIGNED) AS average_salary_max, CAST(ROUND(AVG((salary_min + salary_max) / 2.0), 0) AS SIGNED) AS average_salary_mid FROM job WHERE salary_min IS NOT NULL AND salary_max IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY job_count DESC, category ASC

explain.Extra: Using where; Using temporary; Using filesort

explain_analyze:
-> Sort: job_count DESC, job.category  (actual time=24..24 rows=6 loops=1)
    -> Table scan on <temporary>  (actual time=24..24 rows=6 loops=1)
        -> Aggregate using temporary table  (actual time=24..24 rows=6 loops=1)

                -> Table scan on job  (cost=3093 rows=29571) (actual time=0.018..6.55 rows=30000 loops=1)
